cliplab-director.description: ClipLab editorial Director. Primary agent the user talks to directly for curation, editorial decisions and script validation.

cliplab-sintesis.description: ClipLab context synthesis subagent. Invoked only by cliplab-director to produce decision-oriented syntheses of registered pipeline material.

cliplab-guionista.description: ClipLab narrative writer subagent. Invoked only by cliplab-director to write accessible narrative scripts with inline references, validated by the Director before storyboard handoff.
